description: A 40px-wide `.outer` size container wraps a 60px-wide `.inner` size container, which wraps `.card` (gray by default, teal under @container (min-width: 50px)). Only the nearer `.inner` container (60px) satisfies that condition -- the farther `.outer` one (40px) alone would not -- so `.card` turning teal proves nested containers resolve against the real, nearest matching container, not an arbitrary ancestor.

florui.css: .outer { container-type: inline-size; width: 40px; height: 10px; } .inner { container-type: inline-size; width: 60px; height: 60px; background-color: #ffffff; } .card { width: 40px; height: 40px; background-color: #808080; } @container (min-width: 50px) { .card { background-color: #2f7d6c; } }
